name: BREAST PUMP WITH BOTTLE (A-204)
description:
Further Details

Quantity : 1 BREAT PUMP KIT WITH 240ML WIDE NECK FEEDING BOTTLE
Capacity : N/A
1 BREST PUMP KIT WITH 240 ML FEEDING BOTTLE , WITH MEDIUM FLOW SIZE TEAT & SOFT CILICONE SHELL FOR COMFORT PUMPING

Lightweight Design

The breast pump is a compact design which makes it easier to position. The uniquely designed handle makes milk expressing comfortable and controllable.

Manual Operation

The manual breast pump is designed in such a way that it can be easily operated single handedly. This breast pump is ideal for expressing milk occasionally.

Unique Design for Comfortable Pumping

The breast pump is uniquely designed to make the milk flow pass seamlessly from the breast into the bottle. You can sit comfortably during the entire process without leaning forward to ensure that the milk goes straight into the bottle.

Breast Pump with Massage Cushion

The massage cushion of the breast pump has a velvety texture and gives a comfortable and gentle feeling of milk flow.

Easy Assembly of Parts

The assembly of matching parts is very easy and intuitive.

Compatible with PINK BABY Natural feeding bottles

The PINK BABY manual breast pump is compatible with all NATURAL feeding bottles. PINK BABY offers a wide range of breast care accessories to enhance our comfort and make you breastfeed for longer.

Natural Bottle and Nipple for Natural Latch On

The Ultra-wide breast shaped nipple promotes natural latch on similar to the breast making it easier and comfortable for the baby to combine breast and bottle feeding.

Easy to Clean

PINK BABY manual breast pump is easy to clean due to its small separate parts. It can be easily washed in the dishwasher.

name: FRUIT FEEDER LARGE (FF-210)
description:
Further Details

Quantity : PACK OF ONE
Capacity : N/A
USE 2 TO 3 SMALL PIECES OF FRUITS

DESIGNED WITH FUNCTION IN MIND

These baby fruit and veggie suckers are engineered to allow only the tiniest of food pieces to go through, so as not to pose a choking hazard for your little one. It is a great way to start introducing babies to solid food as they go through the teething phase.

It is also designed with textured surfaces, and soft chewable silicone that ease teething discomfort.

VALUE FOR MONEY

Get more value for your money with PINK BABY’s fruit feeder pacifier and teething toy in one. It can store fresh fruits, vegetables, ice chips, and even medicine.
It can also soothe baby’s teething discomfort by massaging the gums, which builds up mouth muscle, and encourages healthy teeth development.

VERY EASY TO USE

With Ashtonbee’s baby fruit and vegetable pouch, you simply have to place diced fruit or vegetables, snap it shut, and you’re ready to go!

Something so simple comes with so many features and benefits for your baby.
